title: Cozy Autumn
description: It completely replaces the basic lighting with features like glowing sunrises, realistic water reflections, and natural, deep shadows.
body:
# Cozy Autumn

------

This project completely overhauls the game's vanilla lighting engine to deliver a cinematic, hyper-realistic visual experience while maintaining balanced visibility for actual gameplay.

## Features

HDR Tone Mapping: Implements an ACES Filmic curve to compress raw linear light data, preventing blownout highlights and preserving deep, rich contrast in the shadows.

Dynamic Atmosphere: Features custom atmospheric scattering for realistic time-of-day color transitions, combined with exponential depth fog and procedural volumetric clouds.

Advanced Reflections: Utilizes ray-marched Screen-Space Reflections (SSR) with environmental sky fallbacks and physically accurate Fresnel effects for realistic water physics.
